detailed_description: CSS Triangle Generator creates pure CSS triangles using the border technique - no images or SVG required. Simply select the direction (up, down, left, right, or diagonal), set the size and color, and get clean CSS code instantly. The tool generates lightweight, scalable triangles perfect for tooltips, dropdown arrows, breadcrumb separators, and decorative elements. Preview your triangle in real-time and copy the CSS code directly into your stylesheet. A must-have tool for front-end developers.
